title: Self-looping TUI beads worker plugin + tmux launcher
description: Add .opencode/plugins/beads-loop.ts: gated by OPENCODE_BEADS_LOOP env, kicks off a worker round on TUI open, then on session.idle + settle delay re-checks bd ready and submits the next one-bead round via tui.appendPrompt/submitPrompt; /new every 6 rounds for fresh context. Rewrite scripts/launch-beads-workers.sh to launch N worker TUIs as tmux windows (per-worker BEADS_AGENT_ACTOR + OPENCODE_BEADS_LOOP) instead of headless opencode run. Registered in tui.json.
close_reason: beads-loop.ts written (transpile-verified; runtime behavior pending TUI restart), launcher rewritten for tmux TUI mode (bash -n clean), registered in tui.json. Same caveats as beads-status: visual/runtime confirmation on next launch.
